membership_rules.plain_language_rule: Explicit assignment in the source group definition
Closest represented ecological or taxonomic analogue with material mismatch
Broad reporting-category composition approximated by compatible model groups
Unambiguous fit to the documented group definition
Assumed eligible group set from regional taxonomy and source definitions
Verified synonym of a documented source member

allocation_rules.plain_language_rule: Source-model total Yield proportions used as fixed composition proxies across years and catch bases; source zero catches retained
No split required: the full taxon catch is assigned to one group
Identified regional catches pooled across 1950–2019 supply a transferred composition proxy; donor and target reporting populations are not established as equivalent

very_low_decisions.why_very_low: The broad bony-fish label includes all 40 source-listed bony-bearing groups 15–17, 20–48 and 50–57, including mesopelagics, named forage fish, albacore, salmon and juvenile stages. The provider medium-demersal functional bin is not an exhaustive taxonomic definition. Benthic fish16 remains eligible through its actual bony members despite a pooled ratfish component; dedicated Dogfish49, Skates58 and Sharks59 are excluded. Unobserved residual composition, unrepresented taxa and mixed-pool transfer keep membership Very low. Source-model Yield proportions assume a fixed composition across 1950–2019 and catch bases; model zero catches do not establish regional absence.
very_low_decisions.allocation_assumption: Complete author total Yield proportions (denominator 1.6968660588 t/km²/year) are an assumed fixed caught-composition proxy across 1950–2019 and all catch bases. All genuine source-zero candidates remain in the ledger; zeros are model uncaught assumptions, not observed absence. Allocation W4 Medium.
very_low_decisions.report_reason: Forty bony-fish-bearing pools approximate unknown reporting-category composition, including named stocks and juvenile stages. Unrepresented taxa and the mixed ratfish/bony Benthic fish pool limit membership; source Yield proportions assume the same composition across 1950–2019 and catch bases.

very_low_decisions.why_very_low: Primary camera observations establish deep gelatinous/siphonophore feeding. Source35 Nearshore rock. and52 Widow rock. combine substantial explicit gelatinous prey with active coastal/water-column fish predation/planktivory. This is a partial feeding-pathway connection, not source membership or a comparable size/metabolism. Full competing fish-pool review is retained in analogue_review.json: other jelly-positive forage pools emphasize microplankton/filter feeding, mesopelagics emphasize small deep prey, and Yellowtail/Sablefish emphasize euphausiids/fish; jelly presence alone does not make them eligible. Source35 jelly share23.9234% and52 share36% are supporting evidence, not an optimization criterion. Both still consume much non-gelatinous food and differ in habitat/body size/physiology; source Yield weights are a fixed weak composition proxy. Source-model Yield proportions assume a fixed composition across 1950–2019 and catch bases; model zero catches do not establish regional absence.
very_low_decisions.allocation_assumption: Complete source-model total Yield proportions are a fixed caught-composition proxy across 1950–2019 and all catch bases; source zeros retained as model uncaught assumptions.
very_low_decisions.report_reason: Nearshore rock. and Widow rock. partly match sunfish gelatinous feeding, but differ in body size, physiology, habitat and non-gelatinous diet. Source Yield proportions impose a fixed mixture across years and catch bases; neither pool establishes source membership.
